case_name: Rama and Others v State of Rajasthan
respondent:
State of Rajasthan
Supreme Court of India

5 April 2002
Appeal (crl.) 447 of 2002
The Judgment was delivered by : B. N. Agrawal, J.
Leave granted.
1. Judgment impugned in this appeal has been rendered by Jodhpur Bench of the Rajasthan High Court whereby criminal appeal preferred by the appellants has been dismissed confirming the convictions and sentences awarded against the appellants by the trial court under Sections 326 and 325 read with section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The said criminal appeal was filed in the year 1987 and duly admitted. The same was placed for hearing in the year 2001 and after hearing the parties, the High Court passed an order in four pages.
3. The impugned judgment, runs into seven paragraphs and after referring to the prosecution case and defence version , the Court has disposed of the appeal in two paragraphs which run thus:-
"After re-appreciation of the evidence and re-scrutiny of the record, I find that there is no error apparent
facts: The appellants filed a criminal appeal in the year 1987, which was admitted and placed for hearing in the year 2001.
The High Court passed an order in four pages after hearing the parties.
The impugned judgment runs into seven paragraphs and refers to the prosecution case and defence version.
issues: Whether the High Court disposed of the appeal in accordance with law
petitioner_arguments: The procedure adopted by the High Court is unknown to law
A duty is enjoined upon the appellate court to reappraise the evidence itself
Upholding such a procedure would amount to negation of valuable right of appeal of an accused
court_reasoning: The procedure adopted by the High Court is novel and unknown to law
A duty is enjoined upon the appellate court to reappraise the evidence itself
Upholding such a procedure would amount to negation of valuable right of appeal of an accused
holding: The appeal is allowed, the impugned order passed by the High Court is set aside and the matter is remitted to that Court for disposal of the appeal in accordance with law after giving opportunity of hearing to the parties.
